correctness.rationale: Reconstructed all 18,634 simplices from the 49-vertex circular Manhattan metric. The supplied 9,325-event chronological certificate verifies 9,309 genuine free-face collapse pairs and sixteen maximal critical faces with complete coverage, producing an acyclic discrete Morse matching with one critical 0-cell, one critical 3-cell and fourteen critical 4-cells. Signed integer gradient-path recursion gives fourteen exact zero degree maps from 4- to 3-cells. Since maps S^3 to S^3 are classified by degree, the complex has homotopy type S^3 wedged with fourteen S^4. Verification requires the supplied certificate and exact standard-library checker; it does not extrapolate from field homology.

value.rationale: The result explicitly solves a naturally posed 2025 open homotopy-type question for the first 49-vertex scale-three torus grid case. It establishes a complete integral homotopy wedge, not merely a new Betti number or a routine restatement of a table. The certificate isolates the geometric obstruction—fourteen potential attaching maps—and proves them all zero, permitting reproducibility and future comparison with persistence and symmetries.
